for i in range(2,11):
    for j in range(3,12):

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # border cells of the 3-box = nonzero cells; find interior
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=0]
    i0=min(i for i,j in nz); i1=max(i for i,j in nz)
    j0=min(j for i,j in nz); j1=max(j for i,j in nz)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(i0,i1+1):
        for j in range(j0,j1+1):
            if g[i][j]==0:
                d=min(i-i0,i1-i,j-j0,j1-j)
                out[i][j]= 4 if d%2==1 else 2
    return out
